text:
Sophia G: Hey folks — need to lock a slot for the Marigold dedicated deployment review (customer-facing). Prefer next Tue/Wed EOD PT. Goal: walk runbook, network cutover plan, fallback model mapping. Please vote and add agenda items.
Raj P: I can do Tue 3-4pm PT. Can we also do a quick code review check for the autoscale config? pinging @Matt L
Matt L: Tue works for me. I’ll drop the autoscaler diff here: https://internal/repo/diff/4678
Ellie C: Wed afternoon better for me, but I can make Tue if needed. Need clarity on private VPC peering steps — @Tom S any blocker from infra?
Tom S: No blockers. We'll need Marigold's subnet CIDRs and the BGP ASN for the on-prem edge. Please add to the checklist.
Sophia G: added a short agenda in the ticket: https://internal/tickets/MI-214 — agenda: 1) Rollback criteria 2) Network/peering 3) Fallback model mappings 4) Post-deploy smoke tests
Matt L: small ask: can we run the inference smoke tests against a staging Dedicated pool before the handover? That will validate kernel selection.
Raj P: Yes, schedule a 30m dry-run slot. I can own the smoke tests. Who owns canary switch? @Ellie C?
Ellie C: I can own canary switch and monitoring hooks. Will prepare dashboard links.
Tom S: I'll prepare network runbook snippet — putting it in the ticket. Also attaching the BGP checklist here:
```
- verify customer CIDRs
- validate ASN
- confirm NAT rules
- test icmp/tcp to inference GPUs
```
Sophia G: Polls: (1) Tue 3pm PT — :thumbsup: @Matt L @Raj P (2) Wed 4pm PT — :thumbsup: @Ellie C (3) Tue 10am PT — :thinking_face:
deploy-bot: Reminder: attach the signed SOW and IP allowlist before we do any peering.
Sophia G: Ok consensus looks like Tue 3pm PT. Final asks before I send calendar invite: owners for runbook, smoke tests, and post-deploy rollback (short bullets). If you already put them in MI-214 just say 'done'.
Raj P: done (smoke tests)
Ellie C: done (canary + rollback)
Tom S: done (network)
Matt L: done (autoscaler review)
Sophia G: invite sent. Agenda pinned in MI-214. Thanks all — we'll do a 30m dry-run on Mon 16:00 PT to validate staging smoke tests.
